title: The Go Programming Language
summary: Rob Pike's October 2009 Google Tech Talk introducing Go, a new experimental systems language designed for fast builds, concurrency and garbage collection. It covers the goals, syntax and type system.
why: Used as the primary source for what Go's creators originally promised, such as fast compiles, systems-language framing, safety and generics.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: A good starting point is their FAQ page and also the tech talk at youtube
